title: Insurance for EV Charging Stations Against Fire Incidents and Damage to Buildings and Surrounding Vehicles
what_it_is: Insurance for EV Charging Stations Against Fire Incidents and Damage to Buildings and Surrounding Vehicles

sections.label: EV fires and insurance coverage
sections.summary: In 2023, one fire occurred among 16,262 EVs, and the third-party public liability policy covers property damage, personal injury and other third parties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: In 2023, for a vehicle population of 16,262 EVs, there was only one fire incident.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: In relation to the coverage of the insurance policy, as I mentioned in my answer to the hon Member Mr Lim just now, it is a third-party public liability insurance policy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: So, it covers not only damage to property – and the Member mentioned HDB – it also covers personal injury and damage to other third parties as well.
